text: Since 10-08 the meta is the Chardonnay deck: the Cherry deck with Chardonnay for Macaron and Melon Soda for Cherry.
detail: 4T 300G at 4.29G (≈1000×) and 4T 227G at 4.55G from one poster whose Cherry ceiling was about 3T. The Cherry and Melon Soda decks are obsolete.

text: Chardonnay's line crit buff reaches the carries wherever they stand: no Cherry, no move speed.
detail: Crit buffs don't stack, so she replaces Macaron outright. Below 9★ one head-to-head still favoured a 9★ Macaron; most posters say 5★ already wins.

text: Milk and Chardonnay take Pomegranate's beams first through 탄속, at any ATK; the other four go by ATK order.
detail: Brightseeker, Skating Queen, Tea Knight and Cheesecake fill the rest; Scorpion holds 7th. Tiger Lily stays for the sixth beam.

text: Rank on damage, not on the 배 multiple. Pomegranate at Lv.1 doesn't add damage; it only lowers power and inflates the multiple.
Runes: Milk all ATK%; Chardonnay, Pomegranate, Skating Queen, Cheesecake, Tea Knight all skill amp; Brightseeker and Dark Choco haste.
detail: Chardonnay's crit buff scales with skill amp; only her Push RES doesn't.

text: Raid gear: weapons skill amp + crit, top-right haste + skill amp, armour DR + HP, bottom-right haste + DR. No move speed, accuracy or focus.
detail: Season 7 posters split on crit rate, crit dmg or flat ATK beside skill amp on weapons.

text: At Lv.114–118 the 17 s wipe is survivable: 서신우's 2.5T run keeps all twelve alive past it.
detail: Lv.1 fillers show 9.2M HP; fillers levelled to 40–90 live to the last seconds. Level 120 waits on account level 200.

text: Season 7's live #1 is at 10T 266G after a day; the top-10 teams are still unpublished.
detail: Players on both boards are at 1.2–2.7× their Season 6 finals, median 1.84×, before the season ends. Season 6's #1 isn't in the top 100.

text: Among the top 50, score tracks setup more than raw account power.
detail: Season 6: score ÷ account power runs 76–164× (median 110×), and the top-power account (50.8G) placed #19. Account-wide, so not the forum's 배.

text: Expect retries: the main roll now is Pomegranate catching Tiger Lily's 다발 3 past Chardonnay's Push RES.
